# InfoSecurity Global Q4 2024 Earnings Report

## Executive Summary

InfoSecurity Global delivered exceptional financial performance in 2024, reporting record revenue of $8.09 million, representing a robust 37.2% year-over-year growth from the previous year's $5.90 million. The company achieved strong profitability with net income of $1.77 million and maintained a healthy operating margin of 21.9%, demonstrating effective cost management and operational efficiency. This outstanding performance reflects the company's strategic focus on high-value cybersecurity solutions within the manufacturing sector and validates our investment in expanding our workforce to 476 employees to support accelerated growth initiatives.

## Revenue and Profitability Analysis

The company's revenue surge of $2.19 million year-over-year significantly outpaced industry averages, driven by increased demand for specialized cybersecurity solutions in manufacturing environments. Our operating margin of 21.9% positions InfoSecurity Global well above typical industry benchmarks, indicating strong pricing power and efficient service delivery models. The healthy conversion of revenue growth to bottom-line results, with net income representing approximately 22% of total revenue, reflects our disciplined approach to scaling operations while maintaining profitability. This performance was achieved despite strategic investments in talent acquisition, with our employee base supporting approximately $17,000 in revenue per employee, demonstrating strong productivity metrics.

## Business Segment Performance

Our three core service verticals showed strong momentum throughout 2024, with maintenance services continuing to provide stable recurring revenue streams from our established manufacturing client base. Quality control solutions experienced particularly strong growth as manufacturers increasingly prioritize cybersecurity compliance and risk management frameworks. Supply chain security services emerged as a key growth driver, benefiting from heightened awareness of supply chain vulnerabilities and regulatory requirements in the manufacturing sector. The diversified portfolio approach has proven effective in capturing multiple touchpoints within client organizations while reducing concentration risk across our revenue streams.

## Forward-Looking Guidance

Looking ahead to 2025, InfoSecurity Global is well-positioned to sustain strong growth momentum, targeting revenue in the range of $10.5-11.2 million, representing 30-38% growth. We anticipate continued expansion opportunities driven by increasing cybersecurity investments in manufacturing, particularly in IoT security and operational technology protection. The company plans strategic investments in advanced threat detection capabilities and expanded service offerings while maintaining our target operating margin range of 20-23%. With a solid financial foundation and growing market demand for specialized manufacturing cybersecurity solutions, we remain confident in our ability to deliver sustained value creation for stakeholders while supporting the critical security needs of our manufacturing partners.
